snippet.title: FInd Your Words - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Find Your Words is available NOW on Steam! CAPY's latest short adventure game is FREE, with an optional supporter pack you can purchase!

Jump into Camp Pals NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2971960/Find_Your_Words/

This cozy game was created by two dads, celebrating their kids’ journeys to find their voices.

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/yk6hBhpfvw
